QUESTIONS?

Is this another AI sales pitch?

No. The report includes negative evidence, failed projects and claims that did not hold up. Its purpose is to separate real business risk from AI hype.

Is this only for contractors?

Yes — on purpose. Most AI advice tries to serve everyone at once, which is why it feels like noise. This is one room built for contractors. Other industries will get their own.

Is this a PDF?

No. It's a living page you log into. It updates as AI changes, so what you see six months from now is current — not what was true the day you paid. A PDF can't do that.

Does the information ever change?

Yes — that's the point. AI is moving fast, so this isn't a report you read once and file away. New tools, new risks and new shifts that affect contractors get added as they happen. Opt in for text alerts with a link straight into relevant updates.

Do I need to understand AI?

No. It is written for business owners, not developers.

How long does the report take?

The core report reads in roughly 25 minutes. The contractor consult audio is about 20 minutes. Updates are short by design — a couple of minutes to read, or a quick audio rundown for the truck.

Are the statistics sourced?

Yes. Source-backed claims are identified throughout the report, and questionable claims are challenged rather than quietly repeated.

Is there a subscription?

No. It's a one-time $17 purchase, and the ongoing updates are included. You never get billed again.

What happens after I pay?

You get your login and can start reading immediately on your phone, tablet or computer. From then on, log back in whenever you want — and when something changes that affects contractors, you can receive a link if you opt in to text alerts.
